request.style: English, female solo voice with backing choir, Celtic harp, bodhran, fiddle, low strings, haunting and hopeful mood, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Naaman stood in power and pride
Commander of Aram's army wide
Through him the Lord gave victory
But leprosy marked his body
A young girl from Israel's land
Served in Naaman's wife's hand
She spoke of a prophet in Samaria
Who could heal his skin so badly

[Chorus]
Go wash seven times in the Jordan
Let your flesh be clean and restored
The simple word is God's way
Grace that cannot be bought or paid

[Verse]
He came with horses and chariots
To the door of Elisha's house
But the prophet sent a messenger
With words that made Naaman frown
He thought the man would come out
Wave his hand and cure the doubt
Instead he was told to dip
In waters he deemed too small to fix

[Chorus]
Go wash seven times in the Jordan
Let your flesh be clean and restored
The simple word is God's way
Grace that cannot be bought or paid

[Verse]
His servants spoke with gentle care
Why did you turn away in rage
If the prophet asked for greatness
Would you not have done his bidding
So he went down to the river
Dipped himself seven times in the water
His flesh was like a young boy's skin
He was clean and he came back in

[Chorus]
Go wash seven times in the Jordan
Let your flesh be clean and restored
The simple word is God's way
Grace that cannot be bought or paid

[Bridge]
Now I know there is no God in all the earth
Except in Israel's land
So please accept a gift from your servant
For I have found the promise and the plan
But Elisha refused the silver
Saying I will accept nothing
Naaman asked for earth to carry
So he could serve the Lord forever

[Outro]
Only Naaman the Syrian was cleansed
While many lepers went unhealed
Grace found the outsider in the end
